svg.text: MDI order is the datasheet default (CFG_OPT1 pulled down): MDIP0 = pair A = RJ45 pins 1-2.
PoE Alt-A uses those center taps. HSIP/HSIN coupling capacitors sit on the switch sheet, next to the SoC.
Bob Smith: pair A and pair B each have their own 75 ohm and 1 nF. Pairs C and D share one capacitor.
Port 5 RTL8221B PHY address 4 HiSGMII / 2500BASE-X toward the switch
Address strap sets the LED wiring. Flip a lamp in register 7.19 if the polarity is inverted.
One 100 nF at each PHY 3.3 V pin and each 0.95 V pin. Rails are V3V3 and V095_Pn.
